The frozen T500 GPU smoke repaired Rich but first edited production at463.7s, never called EGV and relied on native fallback. This independent candidate permits scoped pre-Patch verification, evidence-driven edit/probe decisions, and earlier reviewed closure. Only Main Prompt changes; agent/eval/child config and child Prompt remain byte-identical. This is a joint workflow treatment, not separately identified early-delegation vs closure effects.

CPU02 is a single complete official Linux acceptance:135/135 =115 original +7 frozen T500 +8 new workflow +3 authorization/window guards +2 exact-budget tests. Actual Compiler/empty-State ADK Runner/tools prove pre-Patch child assertion/report, Main production repair, target/old-behavior retest, diagnostic cleanup and real submit_patch. New candidate native shared cutoff measured500.100s;60 charged-tool boundary denies both roles, with71 raw events including free/denied operations. Model replies are scripted HTTP: no real-Gemma policy compliance or algorithm gain is claimed. CPU01's real Test A audit KeyError is retained and corrected in CPU02 without changing the candidate.

ZIP:d1e815e770abbcc448325ad2a3c8785c62f6d3c63bc7f95700850748c048a487. Actual pinned tokenizer:853 ->1208 Main instruction tokens (+355); latency/net value unmeasured. Child Shell write risk remains auditable, not enforced read-only. CRC and manifest hashes pass. All8947 historical tracked blobs checked;92 pre-existing CRLF checkouts also match pre-task raw SHA records. No old Prompt/ZIP/Trace/JUnit/protocol rewritten.

New paired draft locks rich_3676 A->B and fastapi_14492 B->A outside the old eight reserved tasks. Both fresh native CPU baselines eligible. Model/wheel/input/candidate/order/Notebook hashes frozen; draft unconditionally refuses execution. Current quota~794reported seconds is insufficient and this round has no GPU authorization. No GPU, LoRA or formal submission launched. Existing57402336 remains API PENDING/no Public Score at2026-10-20 13:56Beijing; S0 remains0.13.

See CANDIDATE_DECISION.md for Q1-Q13, MAIN_PROMPT_DIFF.md, CPU_FEEDBACK_LOOP_VALIDATION.md, BUDGET_AND_PERMISSION_AUDIT.md, GPU_MECHANISM_PROTOCOL_DRAFT.*, audit.py and INTEGRITY_MANIFEST.json. Base PR6:59eda9c; final evidence:272c284.
